classification_legend.confirmed: Site demonstrably mutates persistent state (SQL row, Storage object, external provider effect) in retained operational source.
classification_legend.candidate: Lexical match that may be read-only, hash computation, in-memory Map, crypto, comment, or DTO; must be adjudicated before the cut census digest is final.
classification_legend.external: Writer outside repository control (Supabase Auth, Storage service, provider API). Uncontrolled external writer means the cut cannot claim completeness.

barrier_observation_model: Every confirmed SQL writer must lock/check its local barrier row and compare its admitted ingestion generation in the SAME transaction as the mutation. Storage/external writers require a fixed effect owner that participates in the same logical cut. No advisory-only lock, GUC, or self-stamp grant is sufficient.

totals.prior_audit_reference: writer-cut-audit-v2.md identified 123 candidate files / 662 lexical sites (not 662 confirmed writers). This inventory separates confirmed persistent-state mutators from lexical candidates and external classes.

explicit_boundaries.pause_is_finite_opaque: Pause is finite opaque original arrival/body-hash custody only. Queueing is not source qualification, viewer permission, or an automatic right to replay.
explicit_boundaries.unknown_never_equals_drained: UNKNOWN blocks a positive drained claim. Read-only receipt and financial/forensic observation may continue under independently current narrow authority without reopening dispatch.
explicit_boundaries.stop_privacy_security_remain_operational: Independently bounded safety STOP/withdrawal/security denial must not be disabled. Any such source/permission change invalidates the candidate comparison boundary and forces fresh reconciliation.
explicit_boundaries.uncontrolled_writer_means_incomplete: If an external Auth/Storage/provider owner remains uncontrolled or its writer list is incomplete, keep consistent_boundary_proven=false/UNKNOWN.
explicit_boundaries.no_advisory_only: PostgreSQL advisory locks alone only serialize callers that voluntarily participate. No advisory-only/GUC/selfstamp grant.
explicit_boundaries.no_pop_shared_db_claim: Legacy Oracle Supabase 'theoracle' is Oracle-owned. Do not open a POP claim or change POP structure.
explicit_boundaries.business_acceptance_held: Real comparison/cutover/adoption/non-use/retention/removal stays held behind separate business-acceptance gate.
